# mergeah_connector (Data Source)

Read Merge Agent Handler connector. Results are available as JSON via response_json; paginated collections are fetched completely.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
data "mergeah_connector" "example" {
  slug = "linear"
}

locals {
  connector = jsondecode(data.mergeah_connector.example.response_json)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Merge API field `slug`.

### Optional

- `auth_mode` (String) Merge API field `auth_mode`.
- `include_tool_details` (Boolean) Merge API field `include_tool_details`.
- `query` (Map of String) Additional documented API query parameters. All pages are fetched automatically. Values must be strings.

### Read-Only

- `response_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON object for a detail endpoint, or JSON array containing every item for a collection. Use jsondecode to read fields. Sensitive because API records may contain personal data.
